title.uz: Tabiiy olam va inson mehnati mahsuli

recall.uz: Tabiiy olam — inson qoʻli bilan yaratilmagan borliq: daraxtlar, jonivorlar, suv, togʻlar, quyosh. Inson mehnati mahsuli — odamlar yaratgan narsalar: binolar, kiyim, kitob, oʻyinchoqlar.
recall.ru: Природа — это то, что не создано руками человека: деревья, животные, вода, горы, солнце. Творения человека — то, что сделали люди: здания, одежда, книги, игрушки.
recall.en: Nature is everything not made by human hands: trees, animals, water, mountains, the sun. Things people make are created by humans: buildings, clothes, books, toys.

prompt.en: Which one is made by people?

explanation.en: Right! A car is made by people.
